ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What are the consumers of aquatic crustaceans?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The food-web diagram shows several labeled organisms, including "Aquatic crustaceans" near the lower left and "Fish" above it. There is an arrow starting from aquatic crustaceans and pointing upward toward fish. Reasoning: In a food web, an arrow from one organism to another indicates energy moving from the eaten organism to the consumer. Since the arrow goes from aquatic crustaceans to fish, fish are the consumers of aquatic crustaceans.
